title: Explore Club | Holiday Social
description: Kick off the holiday season at OpenTap’s Christmas pop-up with yoga, holiday cheer, festive sips, shopping, swag bags & connection!
long_description:
Kick off the holiday season at OpenTap’s Christmas pop-up with yoga, holiday cheer, festive sips, shopping, swag bags & connection!

About this Event

Join us for our Holiday Social, the third event in the Explore Club, a series designed to bring people together through unique experiences, local businesses, and community.
This festive event is all about kicking off the holiday season, connecting with friends and family, supporting local businesses, and enjoying some holiday fun at OpenTap’s Christmas pop-up.
Spend your Saturday enjoying gentle movement with an outdoor morning flow, festive music, seasonal sips, holiday shopping, local vendors, delicious bites, swag bags, a build-your-own ornament bar, and plenty of opportunities to mingle, celebrate, and get into the holiday spirit.
Come dressed in your favorite holiday gear and ready to celebrate! 🎄✨

Event Details
Date & Time: July 11, 2026 9:00 AM – 11:30 AM (Yoga from 9:30am –10:30am)
Location: OpenTap (5010 Carmel Ctr Dr, Charlotte, NC 28226)

There are several ways to enjoy this experience:
Holiday Yoga + Coffee Experience — $35
